clinic.name: Adventure Dental
clinic.heroSubtitle: Adventure Dental provides specialized pediatric dentistry and orthodontics with a fun, beach-themed approach that makes every visit a tropical escape for children and teens.

differentiators.title: Immersive Island Adventure
differentiators.description: We transport children into a life-like world of tropical fun, turning a dental visit into a memorable island escape.

differentiators.title: Platinum Invisalign Provider
differentiators.description: Our expertise as a top-tier Invisalign provider ensures world-class orthodontic results for patients of all ages.

differentiators.title: Sensory-Aware Accommodations
differentiators.description: We provide dedicated sensory rooms and patient, skilled technicians to support children with special needs.

differentiators.title: Comprehensive Family Care
differentiators.description: While we specialize in pediatrics, we provide a peaceful environment and expert treatment for teens and adults too.

treatmentJourney.title: Warm Welcome & Island Tour
treatmentJourney.description: Your child starts their adventure with a tour of our tropical, beach-themed office led by our friendly Tour Guides.

treatmentJourney.title: Gentle First Exam
treatmentJourney.description: Our pediatric specialists conduct a thorough yet gentle examination while parents consult with the doctor in a relaxed setting.

treatmentJourney.title: Coaching & Preventive Care
treatmentJourney.description: We provide age-appropriate brushing coaching and cleanings to help your child develop lifelong healthy dental habits.

treatmentJourney.title: Child-Centered Treatment
treatmentJourney.description: If repairs are needed, we use child-sized tools and 'tell-show-do' techniques to keep the experience stress-free and positive.

treatmentJourney.title: Advanced Sensory Support
treatmentJourney.description: For kids who need extra care, we utilize our specialized sensory and comfort rooms to ensure they feel safe and supported.

treatmentJourney.title: Ongoing Growing Smiles
treatmentJourney.description: We provide continuous 6-month checkups that evolve with your child, supporting them through their teenage years and beyond.

benefits.title: Fun Tropical Atmosphere
benefits.description: Children can explore a beach-themed world with island adventures while parents relax in our spa-inspired waiting room.

benefits.title: Special Needs Care
benefits.description: Our office features sensory and comfort rooms specifically designed for children who may feel overwhelmed or overstimulated.

benefits.title: Two Decades of Excellence
benefits.description: Celebrating 20 years of providing outstanding dental and orthodontic care to the Vancouver community.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Orthodontics
benefits.description: As a Platinum Invisalign provider, we offer specialized alignment options for children, teenagers, and even adults.

benefits.title: Gentle Teen Crew
benefits.description: Our dedicated Teen Crew approach helps teenagers gain independence and excitement regarding their oral health.

benefits.title: Comforting Tour Guides
benefits.description: Our friendly staff act as Tour Guides to ensure every visit is stress-free, positive, and genuinely enjoyable.

implantOptions.title: Pediatric Dentistry
implantOptions.description: Comprehensive care ensuring your child has a fun, relaxed, and positive experience from their very first tooth.

implantOptions.title: Teen Crew Dental
implantOptions.description: Specialized care focused on encouraging teenagers to take independence and pride in their dental health.

implantOptions.title: Orthodontics & Invisalign
implantOptions.description: Expert orthodontic treatments for all ages, including Platinum status Invisalign services for a smile you'll love.

implantOptions.title: Special Needs Care
implantOptions.description: Sensory-aware treatment and comfort rooms designed to provide a safe space for children who need extra support.

faqItems.question: When should my child's first dental visit happen?
faqItems.answer: We welcome little ones as early as 16 months for their first trip, ensuring a fun and stress-free introduction to dental health.

faqItems.question: How do you handle anxious or scared kids?
faqItems.answer: Our team uses a 'tell-show-do' approach and a beach-themed environment to help nervous children feel safe and excited about their adventure.

faqItems.question: Do you offer support for children with special needs?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we have specialized sensory and comfort rooms and a staff trained to provide a calm, patient, and respectful experience for all children.

faqItems.question: What orthodontic options do you provide?
faqItems.answer: We offer a full range of orthodontic services, including traditional braces and Invisalign, for children, teens, and adults.

faqItems.question: What makes your office different for teenagers?
faqItems.answer: Our 'Teen Crew' focus encourages independence and helps teenagers get excited about maintaining their own dental health in a positive environment.

faqItems.question: What are your office hours?
faqItems.answer: We are available to serve your family Monday through Thursday from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

doctor.name: Todd Hillyard
doctor.bio: Dr. Todd Hillyard is a dedicated specialist at Adventure Dental, bringing years of expertise to pediatric dentistry and orthodontics. He is committed to providing outstanding care and creating a positive, fun environment where children feel at home. Dr. Hillyard works alongside a skilled team to ensure that every patient leaves with a healthy smile and a sense of adventure.

reviews.name: Alexandra C.
reviews.text: Hands down the best children’s dental clinic around!!

reviews.name: Rachel C.
reviews.text: Such a great experience for my kiddos. Friendly and fun. My little ones aren’t afraid of their dentist and it’s such a relief!

reviews.name: Heather L.
reviews.text: My daughter has Down syndrome and can be very overwhelmed. The staff are completely prepared with sensory rooms and patient technicians.

reviews.name: MollyAnn C.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the staff. My son is nervous when going to the dentist and hard to sit still as he gets anxious, but they handled it great.

reviews.name: Asia O.
reviews.text: We had a phenomenal experience for our 16 month old's first trip. They understand kids and how to make it stress free for parents too!

reviews.name: Michelle J.
reviews.text: I'm incredibly impressed: what a cool service! My children were very happy and the doctor answered all my questions. Atmosphere is 10/10.
